title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1981-09-12
source: Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UD-XLII); Transfer Info: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp (24-bit/96 kHz) > Adobe Audition 3.01 (24-bit/96 kHz) > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Audience-sourced recording praised for great sound despite lack of performance details
ai_review.review: The sole five‑star review enthusiastically favors the audience tape, calling it "great sound" and even joking that an AUD source beats a soundboard. No comments are made about the musical execution or specific songs, so the show quality cannot be assessed from this feedback.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review is available; it rates the recording highly and praises its audience source, but provides no insight into the performance itself.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer highlights that the audience recording sounds great and prefers it over a soundboard source.
